_comment: Desired Microsoft Entra ID authentication-methods policy for Halden (P2, lab only). Applied by 08-Set-AuthenticationMethods.ps1. Number matching is required for the Authenticator so a push cannot be approved blind; SMS and voice are disabled where the tenant allows, because they are phishable; Temporary Access Pass is enabled so onboarding is not blocked while a new starter enrols a stronger method. Lifetimes are intentionally short.
